project: Waterton Lakes National Park Aquatic Conservation and Restoration ARU Pilot Program 2021
project_description: Waterton’s Aquatic Conservation and Restoration program is attempting to use ARUs at some subalpine lakes to capture potential changes in breeding bird biodiversity before and after non-native fish removal. SM4 units were deployed at four subalpine lake sites between June and September, 2021 and require data analysis which will include a species inventory, acoustic indices, as well as species richness and abundance.
